Hello. Right now I\'m using my own voice to create an alarm for AlarmTalk. Just imagine waking up every morning to the voice of someone you love. It feels so warm. The weather today is clear, with a gentle breeze drifting by. It\'s a perfect day for a walk. With this voice, I could lovingly greet a family member or friend each morning. Let me count some numbers too. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. On happy days I\'ll smile brightly, and on hard days I shouldn\'t forget to comfort myself by saying, \"You did so well today, too.\" Now let me read a slightly longer sentence. When I wake up at the same time each day, open the window, breathe in the fresh air, and start my day calmly, even my heart feels a little lighter. Thank you for reading clearly all the way to the end.
Please read clearly in your usual voice for 1 to 2 minutes. You can also create it from a voice file or video you already have.
